transcript.text: Hey Eli, before we finalize anything, I need you to restate the exchange offer and the schedule — what you're proposing to give me in return for the PA, and your pickup and return times for this Sunday. And June, once Eli's done, can you confirm the venue's operating limits, especially anything around electrical capacity? I want to get all of that down in writing before I hand over any equipment.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks Rosa. Here's the exchange offer and schedule: In return for borrowing the PA system, I'll provide 36 boxed lunches — 30 regular and 6 vegetarian — with no cash payment. I can pick up the PA on Saturday at 10 AM and return it on Sunday at 8 PM after the reception. June, whenever you're ready, could you confirm the venue's electrical limits so Rosa has everything she needs?
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Here's what I've confirmed on the venue's electrical capacity: Only 600 watts remain available on the shared circuit because the kitchen warmers are using the rest. The two standard speakers together draw 450 watts, which is fine on its own. However, adding the powered subwoofer would raise the total load to 750 watts, which would overload the circuit. So for this Sunday's reception, the PA can run with the two standard speakers, but the powered subwoofer cannot be used at the venue.
